svg.title: W5 full forward range-forward timing breakdown
svg.desc: Post-step average active timing per node for a full forward run. Input wait and token wait are omitted. Backend/data+compute is estimated from submit_ms plus compute_unaccounted_ms because the current doorbell path executes backend work synchronously.
svg.text: W5 full forward: node range-forward active time
Post-step average. input_wait and token/setup wait are omitted. The large blue segment is backend work currently folded into submit_ms/compute_unaccounted_ms.
materialize: cluster/map/descriptor active work, wait removed

g.text: The current log does not isolate pure "submit to work queue then doorbell". Doorbell is synchronous, so backend data movement and compute are mostly charged to submit_ms. Pure submit is expected to be tiny compared with the blue segment.
